description: This file defines options and functions for configuring secure server with loopback certificates in Kubernetes API server, including self-signed certificate generation, health checks, and applying configurations.

classes.name: SecureServingOptionsWithLoopback
classes.description: Struct extending SecureServingOptions with an additional clock for health checks.

classes.name: HealthzLivezHealthChecksAdder
classes.description: Interface for adding health and liveness checks.

classes.name: LoopbackCertificateExpiredError
classes.description: Error type indicating the loopback certificate has expired.

methods.name: WithLoopback
methods.description: Creates a SecureServingOptionsWithLoopback instance with real clock.

methods.name: ApplyTo
methods.description: Applies secure serving options and sets up loopback client config.

methods.name: ApplyToConfig
methods.description: Applies configuration to server config object.

methods.name: addLoopbackServingCertificateHealthCheck
methods.description: Adds a health check for loopback certificate expiry.
